lines.text: A man knelt before Jesus and said his son often falls into the fire or into the water.
Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, who was healed from that moment.
Jesus told the disciples they could not drive it out because they had little faith, and compared faith to a grain of wheat.
In Galilee, Jesus told the disciples the Son of Man would be killed and raised to life on the seventh day.
In Capernaum, Jesus told Peter to catch a fish and use the four-drachma coin in its mouth to pay the tax.
